text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has ended. In order to 
encourage Neo Universe as she finally 
heads toward the Kikuka Sho...

A modest send-off party was held at a 
teppanyaki restaurant near the training 
lodge. The participating members were...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Universe, I didn't run in the Kikuka Sho, 
but... would you mind if I ask something?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The secret to a good run is...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Reception" preparation—complete. The 
trick to it is...?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Eating, of course. At this stall... 
yakisoba, the seafood platter, imoni 
stew—anything's fine."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Just eat, run, and eat. As long as you do 
that, you'll pretty much win.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Beyond observation... Neo Universe is 
different from a "black hole"...

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha... I think Oguri-san is the only 
one who could win every race doing that, 
though.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Please realize it. You are an 
extraordinary super Umamusume known by 
everyone, after all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hm, you think so...? It's quite difficult.

The participants were Oguri Cap and that 
certain Trainer. It was an odd 
combination, but...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ――“SETO”。

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Yes. "SETO" is... one.

Hearing that, it made complete sense. This 
is a send-off party for "SETO."

Everyone we had met through those curious 
twists of fate prayed for Neo Universe's 
success.

And so, after eating and drinking to our 
hearts' content, emptying the restaurant's 
fridge...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Neo Universe gives prior notice.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The next... Kikuka Sho...

Was that a declaration of victory? Turning 
a serious gaze toward Neo Universe...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The next Kikuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The Trainer—is heavily obstructed.

Words completely different from what I 
expected. What could she possibly mean by 
"blocked"?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer—will be blocked by karma. 
Greater than the Japanese Derby. An ocean 
stands in the way.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Even so, you said you would "come." And 
yet――

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Even if they can't come. Or perhaps it's 
fine if they don't.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
A "severance" can act as a buffer— 
Sometimes, it protects things too.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, if we just keep moving forward 
together...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"ABSS"... Towards that sorrowful course. 
And then—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Maybe we'll just end up in the same star 
system.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"If it comes to that, it might be better 
to break away in the previous 'sector'..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Neo Universe is harboring it. In 
other words—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —I'm... "scared."

A forewarning of trouble at the Kikuka 
Sho. Having heard that so clearly...

I could only stand frozen in place. Neo 
Universe simply stared, as if clinging on, 
yet pushing away.
